create EXTERNAL table ods_base_category1
(
    id           bigint,
    name         varchar(10) ,
    create_time  DATETIME2   ,
    operate_time DATETIME2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_base_category1/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_base_category2
(
    id           bigint,
    name         varchar(10) ,
    category1_id bigint,
    create_time  DATETIME2   ,
    operate_time DATETIME2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_base_category2/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_base_category3
(
    id           bigint,
    name         varchar(10) ,
    category2_id bigint,
    create_time  DATETIME2   ,
    operate_time DATETIME2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_base_category3/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);


create EXTERNAL table ods_base_province
(
    id           bigint      ,
    name         varchar(20) ,
    region_id    varchar(20) ,
    area_code    varchar(20) ,
    iso_code     varchar(20) ,
    iso_3166_2   varchar(20) ,
    create_time  DATETIME2    ,
    operate_time DATETIME2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_base_province/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_base_region
(
    id           varchar(20) ,
    region_name  varchar(20) ,
    create_time  DATETIME2    ,
    operate_time DATETIME2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_base_region/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_base_trademark
(
    id           bigint ,
    tm_name      varchar(100) ,
    logo_url     varchar(200) ,
    create_time  datetime2     ,
    operate_time datetime2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_base_trademark/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_order_detail
(
    id                    bigint ,
    order_id              bigint        ,
    sku_id                bigint         ,
    sku_name              varchar(200)   ,
    img_url               varchar(200)   ,
    order_price           decimal(10, 2),
    sku_num               bigint         ,
    create_time           datetime2       ,
    split_total_amount    decimal(16, 2) ,
    split_activity_amount decimal(16, 2) ,
    split_coupon_amount   decimal(16, 2) ,
    operate_time          datetime2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_order_detail/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_payment_info
(
    id               int,
    out_trade_no     varchar(50),
    order_id         bigint,
    user_id          bigint,
    payment_type     varchar(20),
    trade_no         varchar(50),
    total_amount     decimal(10, 2),
    subject          varchar(200),
    payment_status   varchar(20),
    create_time      datetime2,
    callback_time    datetime2,
    callback_content varchar(1000),
    operate_time     datetime2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_payment_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_sku_info
(
    id              bigint ,
    spu_id          bigint            ,
    price           decimal           ,
    sku_name        varchar(200)     ,
    sku_desc        varchar(2000)     ,
    weight          decimal(10, 2)    ,
    tm_id           bigint           ,
    category3_id    bigint           ,
    sku_default_img varchar(300)      ,
    is_sale         int ,
    create_time     datetime2          ,
    operate_time    datetime2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_sku_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_spu_info
(
    id           bigint ,
    spu_name     varchar(200) ,
    description  varchar(1000) ,
    category3_id bigint       ,
    tm_id        bigint       ,
    create_time  datetime2     ,
    operate_time datetime2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_spu_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table ods_user_info
(
    id           bigint ,
    login_name   varchar(200) ,
    nick_name    varchar(200) ,
    passwd       varchar(200) ,
    name         varchar(200) ,
    phone_num    varchar(200) ,
    email        varchar(200) ,
    head_img     varchar(200) ,
    user_level   varchar(200) ,
    birthday     varchar(20)         ,
    gender       varchar(1)  ,
    create_time  datetime2     ,
    operate_time datetime2     ,
    status       varchar(200)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_user_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);
